create_offloader_from_server_args: create an offloader instance from server arguments with CPU offload or sharded GPU modes
wrap_modules_offload_to_cpu: wrap PyTorch modules to offload their parameters to CPU when memory budget allows
get_offloader: get the current singleton offloader instance used by the runtime
set_offloader: set a custom offloader instance as the singleton for the runtime
create_device_tensor_sharded_gpu: create a device tensor by gathering sharded GPU parameters across distributed ranks
